name: PAN Card (Permanent Account Number)
summary: A 10-character alphanumeric identifier issued to individuals, families, and entities for tax and financial transactions.
eligibility: Any individual, HUF, company, or entity that pays tax or conducts specified financial transactions in India
No minimum age — minors can apply through a guardian
documents: Proof of identity (Aadhaar, voter ID, passport, or driving licence)
Proof of address (Aadhaar, utility bill, bank statement)
Proof of date of birth (birth certificate, matriculation certificate, passport)
fee: ₹107 (₹91 + GST) for an Indian communication address; ₹1,017 (₹862 + GST) for a foreign address. Instant e-PAN via Aadhaar on the e-filing portal is free.
process: Apply online via the Protean (formerly NSDL) portal or UTIITSL, or get an instant free e-PAN via the Income Tax e-filing portal using Aadhaar
Upload/submit identity, address, and DOB proofs
Complete e-KYC or send physical documents if not e-signing
Pay the fee and track application status online
Receive e-PAN by email and physical card by post (7-15 working days)
source: Income Tax Department / Protean eGov Technologies

faq.question: Can I get a PAN card for free?
faq.answer: Yes — an instant e-PAN linked to your Aadhaar is free via the Income Tax e-filing portal, provided your mobile number is linked to Aadhaar. A physical card or non-Aadhaar-based application carries the standard fee.

faq.question: How long does a PAN card take to arrive?
faq.answer: e-PAN is typically issued within a few hours to 2 days. The physical card is dispatched by post and generally arrives within 15 working days.
